metadata.title: Real-mode data platform / analytics pipeline (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.description: Batch and near-real-time analytics over IoT and application telemetry with curated datasets for BI and ML feature stores.
reviewObjectives: Optimize compute spend for bursty ETL without missing SLAs
Validate medallion layer isolation and access boundaries
Confirm lineage and PII tagging for regulated feeds
constraints: Nightly SLAs: curated marts ready by 06:00 local
Raw retention 13 months; curated retention 7 years
No direct analyst access to bronze containers

inputSummary: Medallion lakehouse on ADLS with Synapse pools and Purview lineage. Synthetic data-platform archetype for cohort expansion.

qualityEvidence.notes: Cost-led exemplar; recordings still carry topology/compliance findings for recall probes.
